description: This Java class 'GeoWorker' provides utility methods for geographic data processing within the Apache OFBiz framework, including expanding geographic groups and regions, checking for geographic entities, and retrieving the latest geographic points.

classes.name: GeoWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for geographic data operations such as expanding geo groups/regions, checking geo containment, and retrieving latest geo points.

methods.name: expandGeoGroup
methods.description: Expands a geographic group identified by geoId or a GenericValue, returning a list of member geos.

methods.name: expandGeoRegionDeep
methods.description: Recursively expands geographic regions based on geoId mappings, considering regional associations.

methods.name: containsGeo
methods.description: Checks if a list of geos contains a specific geo identified by geoId or a GenericValue.

methods.name: findLatestGeoPoint
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent geographic point entity based on specified identifiers and date.

methods.name: getMeasurementSystem
methods.description: Determines the measurement system (IMPERIAL or METRIC) based on locale.
